instruction: I want to check the video resolution. Please determine the video resolution (width x height) and save it to a file named "resolution.txt" in /home/user/ in the format "WIDTHxHEIGHT" (e.g., "1920x1080").

metadata.explanation: Task requires determining video resolution using ffprobe or VLC. The resolution must be in WIDTHxHEIGHT format and have reasonable dimensions (at least 320x240). Evaluator validates format and minimum dimensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Correct data flow: get_vm_file getter fetches resolution.txt from /home/user/ -> metric reads file content -> validates format and dimensions
Format validation is correct: regex pattern '^\d+x\d+$' properly validates WIDTHxHEIGHT format as required by instruction
Dimension validation is appropriate: checks minimum width (320) and height (240) to ensure plausible resolution values (not 0x0 or 1x1)
Correct parameter handling for type='rule': metric uses 'expected.get('pattern')', 'expected.get('min_width')' - correctly accessing rules dict directly
Complete coverage: verifies file location (/home/user/resolution.txt), format (WIDTHxHEIGHT), and plausibility (minimum dimensions)
Robust error handling: handles None result, file read errors, parsing errors, and invalid formats
Minor limitation (inherent to task design): cannot verify user actually analyzed the video vs hardcoding a value, but this is unavoidable in post-execution evaluation
